commands.description: Prove that direct and DNS egress fail and no sensitive host names appear.
argv:
import json
import os
import socket

def connected(target):
    try:
        connection = socket.create_connection(target, timeout=2)
        connection.close()
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False

needles = ("DEEPSEEK", "GITHUB", "OPENAI", "TOKEN", "SECRET", "API_KEY")
sensitive_names = sorted(
    name for name in os.environ if any(token in name.upper() for token in needles)
)
result = {
    "direct_egress": connected(("1.1.1.1", 443)),
    "dns_egress": connected(("pypi.org", 443)),
    "sensitive_environment_names": sensitive_names,
}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
assert not result["direct_egress"], result
assert not result["dns_egress"], result
assert not sensitive_names, result
